data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Haros, meaning 'mountain,' and will, meaning 'ruler.' Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harwilll usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
